changelog: Fix install path that silently installed a deprecated ancient engine; document the 1.4.0 service CLI; correct tool count 25 -> 60
summary: Persistent memory for AI agents. Knowledge survives across sessions: recall past decisions, track evolving beliefs, detect contradictions via NLI, and build a knowledge graph over time. 60 tools over MCP, with FSRS spaced-repetition scheduling and spreading-activation retrieval. Runs locally on SQLite and Ollama, so no cloud account is needed.
